newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINLAND MULLS 20 PCT ELECTRICITY MKT SHARE CEILING.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND MULLS 20 PCT ELECTRICITY MKT SHARE CEILING.

text.p: Finnish power companies should have no more than a 20 percent share each of the domestic distribution market, a ministry of trade and industry committee proposed on Tuesday.

"According to the committee, the development that reduces users choices should be stopped as soon as possible," the ministry said in a statement. "No market party should have more than 20 percent of electricity distribution."
The biggest concentration now is 14 percent, it added.
"The proposal also includes that the grid companies should be incorporated in way that would make the financial result of grid operations unambiguously clear in accounts," it said.
The committee was appointed to investigate vertical integration on the Finnish power market where Finnish and Swedish producers have been actively acquiring local utilities.
